notes.title: Optimization Update + More
notes.notes:
[h3]Game File Size Optimization[/h3][p]
A considerable size optimization for the game, from the hefty 33.5gb, the game now only takes 8.5gb of space. That's my bad folks, I had forgot to set the compression methods correctly, most of the filesize was from textures and lightmaps. The compression may have a barely visible effect on texture quality.

[/p][h3]Skills system overhaul[/h3][p]
Overhauled the Skills system, now instead of 3 main attributes and 6 skills, we now only have 3 main skills: Resolve, Finesse, and Cunning. As it was in the first game, with some changes.

[b]With this change, I have also added an elixir that allows you to reset your skillpoints. It is highly recommended since the old variable values are not checked during gameplay, and should be reset to achieve your full potential![/b]

[/p][h3]Combat Balancing[/h3][p]
With the skill system overhaul also comes combat balancing. The game should now be a little bit harder, enemies have more health and reach. Dodging their attacks may be a bit more difficult. The amount of mana potions was cut greatly, you can't craft them anymore, and you'll have less health potions too, though it may still be too much. 

Let me know how these changes feel.


 Resolve is for Health and Mana points.
 Finesse is for Attack dmg and persuasion skill checks
 Cunning is for picking pockets, picking locks, and deception attempts.

[/p][h3]Minor changes[/h3][p]

 Added a recipes menu.
 Changed menu buttons to be more prominent for social, feedback, etc.
[/p]

notes.title: For Evelyn II - Early Access starts NOW!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve been pouring our hearts into this game, and now we’re finally ready to share it with you. This next chapter takes everything you loved from the first game and cranks it up: More story, more choices, more strategy, more everything.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why Early Access?[/h2][p]We believe games are better when built [i]with[/i] the community. Early Access lets us gather real feedback, test ideas, and fine-tune the game based on how [b]you[/b] play. Your input will help shape the final version into something more polished, balanced, and fun.[/p][p][/p][h3]How long will it be in Early Access?[/h3][p]We’re aiming for [b]6–12 months[/b], but we're open to taking more time if needed to get everything right. Quality comes first.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's coming in the full version?[/h3][p]More story, more content, more features. We'll be expanding on everything, levels, mechanics, polish, performance, and visuals, based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s in the game right now?[/h3][p]The current version is playable and includes the core systems, real-time combat, and a chunk of the story. It's stable and fun, but still a work in progress, expect some rough edges as we continue development.[/p][p][/p][h3]Will the price change later?[/h3][p]Yes. The full release will be priced higher, so Early Access players get it at a discount as a thank you for jumping in early and helping out.[/p][p][/p][h3]How are you involving the community?[/h3][p]We’re listening. Whether it’s through forums, socials, or in-game feedback, we want to hear what you think. Your suggestions, bug reports, and ideas will directly influence where the game goes next. We are also taking NPC suggestions, send your designs via the link in the game main menu![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]This is just the beginning, more updates and chapters are on the way, and your feedback will help shape where things go from here. So dive in, experiment, and tell us what you love (or don’t, we can take it).[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for supporting the journey. We seriously can’t wait to hear what you think![/p]

notes.title: For Evelyn II - Early Access July 30th
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="cY6B_pw2gUA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Why Early Access?[/b]
We believe great games are made with their communities. Early Access lets us gather feedback, test ideas, and improve gameplay based on real player experiences. Your input will help shape a more polished, balanced, and fun final game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How long will the game be in Early Access?[/b]
We're aiming for 6–12 months, but that may change depending on feedback and development needs. Our priority is delivering a complete, high-quality experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How will the full version differ from Early Access?[/b]
The full release will expand on the Early Access foundation with more content—levels, features, mechanics—and improvements based on player feedback. Expect better performance, visuals, balance, and overall polish.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What is the current state of the game?[/b]
The Early Access version is fully playable, featuring core mechanics, several levels, and a stable experience. Some features are still being refined, and more content is planned. Your feedback will help guide future development.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Will the price change after Early Access?[/b]
Yes, the price will increase at full release. Early Access players get a lower price as thanks for supporting development.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How will the community be involved?[/b]
Player feedback is vital. We’ll gather suggestions, bug reports, and balance input through forums, social media, and surveys. Development updates will be shared regularly, and community input will help shape the game's future.[/p][p][/p][p](Patreon backers get immediate access.)[/p]

notes.title: For Evelyn 2 - ANOTHER Demo Update with Quality-Of-Life adjustments!
notes.notes:
Oh hi! You're here! Quality-of-life update is out! Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] The Warwitch Boss no longer throws fireballs that stay there floating in mid-air. This makes the battle at least a little easier.
[*] Talking about making battles easier, the Tide Stone now allows the player to slow time around them, allowing more maneuverability during combat. Very useful yes?
[*] Added more clear instructions for the player on what to do and how etc.
[*] The button to highlight interactables can now be held down. No more unnecessary button mashing! Yay!
[*] Many of the resources that can be claimed now have a recognizable symbol on them, allowing the player to notice them easier.
[*] Some environments have gotten more detail, new furniture and decorations and such.
[*] Whitescar Keep has been updated to better reflect what the interior looks like.
[*] Some random fixes
[/list]

notes.title: For Evelyn 2 - Demo Update with NEW STUFF!
notes.notes:
Well hello there! I'm back at it again with a NEW UPDATE! This time we have many new treats for you!

- Added the first [b]Void Stone[/b], the Tidestone, which allows the player to run super fast. Yes, it's fun. More magical items coming! Yay for magic!

- Modified battle system a bit more, and also added a [b]new battle scene[/b] with multiple enemies.

- Added the [b]Lore Index![/b] Bunch of new text, with detailed information about characters, locations, and factions. (Some lore may be subject to change and shorter texts may be rewritten with more detail.) You need to find scrolls and books with lore and it will be added to the Index to be read at any time.

- Added more lootable items and most importantly, [b]money![/b] No longer need to sell all your ingredients or potions to be able to afford the always so useful armor pieces that were added in a past update.

- Updated to a [b]new Unity version[/b] due to a weird editor bug. It's all fixed now but I had to re-bake all lighting in every scene. It took me at least 87 years.

- Fixed some silly bugs and people being able to [i]walk through walls and fireplaces[/i]. Ouch?

- Added simple tutorials for skills, magic, and battle stuffs. Remember to assign those character points! 
[b]>:([/b]

- Added a spinning loading graphic that shows up when the game is loading, so no more just black screen during scene changes.

notes.title: For Evelyn 2 - Battle System Update + more!
notes.notes:
The Battle System for For Evelyn II has been updated. With it the player now has a crossbow in their arsenal along with the dagger, and can now damage enemies from afar. The enemy AI also has changed, with upgraded detection and actions. There is also a new bossfight that replaces the old Warwitch Leader. 

The player now also has the ability to buy and sell equipment, including armor!

More:
- Added new random NPCs around the maps
- New Options menus for graphical settings and input settings
- Updated Auron VA
- General quality of life improvements
